newsitem.title: USA: US Midco spot prods notionally mixed post-holiday.
newsitem.headline: US Midco spot prods notionally mixed post-holiday.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot refined products were notionally mixed Thursday, with cash trade razor-thin following the Christmas Day holiday.
NYMEX unleaded prices drifted down 0.05 cent a gallon while heating oil fell 1.34 cents a gallon.
Lower heating oil futures pushed down outright values for jet fuel and diesel in the Midwest and Chicago markets,
Prompt low sulphur diesel in Chicago was talked between 7.25 and 7.00 under the January heating oil futures.
Unleaded in the Midcontinent saw a 4.75 to 4.50 discount to NYMEX.
Meanwhile, Group diffs for low sulphur ranged 6.50 to 6.25 cents below the screen, while the unleaded basis was 4.00 to 3.50 below NYMEX.
Traders said diffs and outright prices were uncertain due to a lack of quotes or deals on Thursday.
